前言：哎呀气死我了，下个esp32拓展下了一个小时还失败了，我开github加速了呀......<br>
<font size="4">本着不服就干的原则，我特此写了一个Arduino ESP32拓展加速下载程序</font><br>
<font size="3">需求：python3</font><br>
<font size="3">安装所需库：</font><br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Bash shell] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: bash; gutter: true">pip install requests windows-curses</pre></div><br>
使用教程：<br>
<br>
零、打开arduino，按ctrl+,进入首选项，往其他开发板管理器地址里粘贴 https://jihulab.com/esp-mirror/espressif/arduino-esp32/-/raw/gh-pages/package_esp32_index_cn.json<br>
一、从极狐ESP32源列表（jihulab.com/esp-mirror/espressif/arduino-esp32/-/raw/gh-pages/package_esp32_index_cn.json）下载package_esp32_index_cn.json文件保存，与脚本同目录<br>
二、python down.py打开脚本<br>
三、选择要下载的版本<br>
<img id="aimg_lFhcN" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" width="585" height="967" file="https://s3.bmp.ovh/2026/08/06/Xz0TQBm6.png" border="0" alt="" src="https://s3.bmp.ovh/2026/08/06/Xz0TQBm6.png"><br>
四、选择要下载版本的系统类别（64位windows选x86_64-mingw32）<br>
五、选择不要下载的文件（直接按enter即可，若已有某些文件可按空格取消勾选）<br>
六、开始8线程gh-proxy加速下载！<br>
七、下载后的文件会保存在./down文件夹，请手动复制里面的全部文件到C:\Users\（你的用户名）\AppData\Local\Arduino15\staging\packages目录下<br>
八、重启arduino，在开发板管理器中找到espressif的的esp32，安装你在“三”选择下载的版本<br>
九、arduino应该会跳过下载，直接开始安装，安装完毕即可食用<br>
<br>
下载脚本：<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Python] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: python; gutter: true"># pip install requests windows-cursesimport json
import os
import hashlib
import threading
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import requests
import curses
from collections import OrderedDict

# ====================== 配置区 ======================
INDEX_JSON_PATH = "./package_esp32_index_cn.json"
DOWNLOAD_DIR = "./down"
MAX_WORKERS = 8
GH_PROXY_PREFIX = "https://gh-proxy.com/"
# ====================================================

# 全局共享任务状态 + 锁（线程安全）
task_lock = threading.Lock()
tasks_status = OrderedDict()
# 状态枚举
STATE_PENDING = "Pending"
STATE_DOWNLOADING = "Downloading"
STATE_SKIP = "Skip"
STATE_SUCCESS = "Success"
STATE_FAILED = "Failed"


def proxy_github_url(raw_url: str) -&gt; str:
    if raw_url.startswith("https://github.com/"):
        return GH_PROXY_PREFIX + raw_url
    return raw_url


def calc_sha256(file_path: str) -&gt; str:
    hash_obj = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
        while chunk := f.read(1024 * 1024):
            hash_obj.update(chunk)
    return hash_obj.hexdigest().lower()


def human_size(byte: float) -&gt; str:
    """字节转易读单位"""
    units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"]
    val = byte
    uidx = 0
    while val &gt; 1024 and uidx &lt; len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1024
        uidx += 1
    return f"{val:.2f}{units[uidx]}"


def download_task(task_id: int, item: dict):
    url = item["url"]
    fname = item["archiveFileName"]
    expect_sha_raw = item["checksum"]
    expect_sha = expect_sha_raw.replace("SHA-256:", "").strip().lower()
    save_path = os.path.join(DOWNLOAD_DIR, fname)

    # 初始化任务状态
    with task_lock:
        tasks_status[task_id] = {
            "name": fname,
            "state": STATE_PENDING,
            "total": 0,
            "current": 0,
            "speed": 0.0,
            "start_time": 0.0,
            "error": "",
            "last_bytes": 0,
            "last_time": 0.0
        }

    # 文件存在校验
    if os.path.exists(save_path):
        if calc_sha256(save_path) == expect_sha:
            with task_lock:
                tasks_status[task_id]["state"] = STATE_SKIP
            return True
        else:
            os.remove(save_path)

    dl_url = proxy_github_url(url)
    try:
        resp = requests.get(dl_url, stream=True, timeout=300)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        total_len = int(resp.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))

        now_init = time.time()
        with task_lock:
            tasks_status[task_id]["state"] = STATE_DOWNLOADING
            tasks_status[task_id]["total"] = total_len
            tasks_status[task_id]["current"] = 0
            tasks_status[task_id]["start_time"] = now_init
            tasks_status[task_id]["last_bytes"] = 0
            tasks_status[task_id]["last_time"] = now_init

        downloaded = 0
        with open(save_path, "wb") as f:
            for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=1024 * 1024):
                if not chunk:
                    continue
                f.write(chunk)
                chunk_len = len(chunk)
                downloaded += chunk_len
                now = time.time()

                with task_lock:
                    info = tasks_status[task_id]
                    delta_t = now - info["last_time"]
                    delta_byte = downloaded - info["last_bytes"]
                    
                    if delta_t &gt; 0.2:
                        instant_speed = delta_byte / delta_t
                        smooth_speed = instant_speed * 0.7 + info["speed"] * 0.3
                        info["speed"] = smooth_speed
                        info["last_bytes"] = downloaded
                        info["last_time"] = now
                    
                    info["current"] = downloaded

        actual_sha = calc_sha256(save_path)
        if actual_sha != expect_sha:
            raise Exception(f"SHA256校验不匹配")
        with task_lock:
            tasks_status[task_id]["state"] = STATE_SUCCESS
        return True

    except Exception as e:
        err_msg = str(e)
        if os.path.exists(save_path):
            os.remove(save_path)
        with task_lock:
            tasks_status[task_id]["state"] = STATE_FAILED
            tasks_status[task_id]["error"] = err_msg
        return False


def curses_render(stdscr):
    """下载进度UI"""
    curses.curs_set(0)
    stdscr.nodelay(True)
    stdscr.timeout(100)

    bar_width = 30
    while True:
        stdscr.erase()
        y = 0
        max_y, max_x = stdscr.getmaxyx()

        stdscr.addstr(y, 0, f"ESP32 Package Downloader | Threads:{MAX_WORKERS}", curses.A_BOLD)
        y += 1
        stdscr.addstr(y, 0, "-" * min(70, max_x))
        y += 1

        with task_lock:
            snapshot = list(tasks_status.items())

        for tid, info in snapshot:
            if y &gt;= max_y - 2:
                stdscr.addstr(y, 0, "...more tasks below")
                break

            name = info["name"]
            state = info["state"]
            curr = info["current"]
            total = info["total"]
            speed = info["speed"]

            disp_name = name[:32] if len(name) &gt; 32 else name
            attr = 0

            if state == STATE_SKIP:
                line = f"[{tid:2d}] {disp_name:&lt;32} [SKIP]"
                attr = curses.A_DIM
            elif state == STATE_SUCCESS:
                line = f"[{tid:2d}] {disp_name:&lt;32} [SUCCESS]"
                attr = curses.A_BOLD
            elif state == STATE_FAILED:
                line = f"[{tid:2d}] {disp_name:&lt;32} [FAILED]"
                attr = curses.A_BOLD
            elif state == STATE_PENDING:
                line = f"[{tid:2d}] {disp_name:&lt;32} [PENDING]"
                attr = curses.A_DIM
            elif state == STATE_DOWNLOADING:
                if total &gt; 0:
                    pct = curr / total
                    fill = int(pct * bar_width)
                    bar = "[" + "#" * fill + "-" * (bar_width - fill) + "]"
                    txt = f"{pct:.1%}"
                else:
                    bar = "[?????]"
                    txt = "UnknownSize"
                speed_str = human_size(speed) + "/s"
                size_str = f"{human_size(curr)}/{human_size(total)}"
                line = f"[{tid:2d}] {disp_name:&lt;32} {bar} {txt:6} {size_str:&lt;18} {speed_str}"
                attr = 0

            stdscr.addstr(y, 0, line, attr)
            y += 1

        stdscr.refresh()
        all_done = True
        with task_lock:
            for v in tasks_status.values():
                if v["state"] in (STATE_PENDING, STATE_DOWNLOADING):
                    all_done = False
                    break
        if all_done:
            break

        try:
            ch = stdscr.getch()
            if ch == ord("q"):
                break
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(0.1)


# ====================== 原生curses菜单工具函数 ======================
def curses_select_menu(stdscr, title: str, options: list[str]) -&gt; int:
    """单选菜单，返回选中索引，上下箭头移动，回车确认"""
    curses.curs_set(0)
    current = 0
    while True:
        stdscr.erase()
        h, w = stdscr.getmaxyx()
        stdscr.addstr(0, 0, title, curses.A_BOLD)
        stdscr.addstr(1, 0, "↑ ↓ 移动，Enter 确认")
        max_show = h - 4
        start = max(0, current - max_show + 1)
        for idx in range(start, min(start + max_show, len(options))):
            opt = options[idx]
            y = 3 + idx - start
            if idx == current:
                stdscr.addstr(y, 0, f"&gt; {opt}", curses.A_REVERSE)
            else:
                stdscr.addstr(y, 0, f"  {opt}")
        stdscr.refresh()
        ch = stdscr.getch()
        if ch == curses.KEY_UP:
            current = max(0, current - 1)
        elif ch == curses.KEY_DOWN:
            current = min(len(options)-1, current + 1)
        elif ch == ord('\n'):
            return current
        elif ch == ord('q'):
            raise KeyboardInterrupt("用户退出菜单")


def curses_checkbox_menu(stdscr, title: str, item_list: list[dict]) -&gt; list[dict]:
    """复选菜单：空格切换勾选，回车确认；item: {"checked":bool, "name":str, "data":object}"""
    curses.curs_set(0)
    current = 0
    while True:
        stdscr.erase()
        h, w = stdscr.getmaxyx()
        stdscr.addstr(0, 0, title, curses.A_BOLD)
        stdscr.addstr(1, 0, "↑↓移动 | [空格]切换勾选 | Enter确认 | q退出")
        max_show = h - 4
        start = max(0, current - max_show + 1)
        for idx in range(start, min(start + max_show, len(item_list))):
            it = item_list[idx]
            mark = "[&amp;#10003;]" if it["checked"] else "[ ]"
            line = f"{mark} {it['name']}"
            y = 3 + idx - start
            if idx == current:
                stdscr.addstr(y, 0, line, curses.A_REVERSE)
            else:
                stdscr.addstr(y, 0, line)
        stdscr.refresh()
        ch = stdscr.getch()
        if ch == curses.KEY_UP:
            current = max(0, current - 1)
        elif ch == curses.KEY_DOWN:
            current = min(len(item_list)-1, current + 1)
        elif ch == ord(' '):
            item_list[current]["checked"] = not item_list[current]["checked"]
        elif ch == ord('\n'):
            return [x["data"] for x in item_list if x["checked"]]
        elif ch == ord('q'):
            raise KeyboardInterrupt("用户退出菜单")


def main():
    os.makedirs(DOWNLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    with open(INDEX_JSON_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        index_data = json.load(f)

    # 1. 提取所有 esp32 platform 版本
    esp32_package = None
    all_platforms = []
    packages = index_data.get("packages", [])
    for pkg in packages:
        if pkg.get("name") == "esp32":
            esp32_package = pkg
            for plat in pkg.get("platforms", []):
                if plat.get("name") == "esp32":
                    all_platforms.append(plat)
            break
    if not esp32_package:
        print("错误：未找到 name='esp32' 的package节点")
        return
    if not all_platforms:
        print("错误：未读取到任何esp32 platform版本")
        return

    # 菜单1：选择Platform版本
    try:
        plat_options = [f"version: {p['version']}" for p in all_platforms]
        sel_idx = curses.wrapper(curses_select_menu, "=== 选择 ESP32 Platform 版本 ===", plat_options)
        selected_platform = all_platforms[sel_idx]
        TARGET_PLATFORM_VERSION = selected_platform["version"]
        print(f"已选择平台版本: {TARGET_PLATFORM_VERSION}")
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("用户取消操作，退出")
        return

    # 菜单2：选择host架构（固定8种host列表）
    host_list = [
        "x86_64-pc-linux-gnu",
        "aarch64-linux-gnu",
        "arm-linux-gnueabihf",
        "i686-pc-linux-gnu",
        "x86_64-apple-darwin",
        "arm64-apple-darwin",
        "i686-mingw32",
        "x86_64-mingw32"
    ]
    try:
        host_idx = curses.wrapper(curses_select_menu, "=== 选择目标 Host 架构 ===", host_list)
        SELECTED_HOST = host_list[host_idx]
        print(f"已选择Host架构: {SELECTED_HOST}")
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("用户取消操作，退出")
        return

    # 收集待下载文件
    download_list = []
    # platform本体包
    core_item = {
        "url": selected_platform["url"],
        "archiveFileName": selected_platform["archiveFileName"],
        "checksum": selected_platform["checksum"]
    }
    download_list.append(core_item)

    # 构建tool映射
    tool_map = {}
    tools_list = esp32_package.get("tools", [])
    for tool in tools_list:
        t_name = tool["name"]
        t_ver = tool["version"]
        if t_name not in tool_map:
            tool_map[t_name] = {}
        tool_map[t_name][t_ver] = tool

    deps = selected_platform.get("toolsDependencies", [])
    for dep in deps:
        dep_name = dep["name"]
        dep_ver = dep["version"]
        if dep_name not in tool_map or dep_ver not in tool_map[dep_name]:
            print(f"[WARNING] 无法匹配工具: {dep_name} = {dep_ver}")
            continue
        tool_info = tool_map[dep_name][dep_ver]
        for sys_entry in tool_info.get("systems", []):
            host = sys_entry.get("host")
            if host == SELECTED_HOST:
                item = {
                    "url": sys_entry["url"],
                    "archiveFileName": sys_entry["archiveFileName"],
                    "checksum": sys_entry["checksum"]
                }
                download_list.append(item)

    # 去重
    unique_items = []
    seen_names = set()
    for it in download_list:
        fn = it["archiveFileName"]
        if fn not in seen_names:
            seen_names.add(fn)
            unique_items.append(it)
    download_list = unique_items

    # 菜单3：文件勾选列表，默认全部勾选
    checkbox_items = []
    for entry in download_list:
        checkbox_items.append({
            "checked": True,
            "name": entry["archiveFileName"],
            "data": entry
        })
    try:
        final_download_list = curses.wrapper(
            curses_checkbox_menu,
            "=== 确认下载清单（空格取消不需要的文件） ===",
            checkbox_items
        )
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("用户取消操作，退出")
        return

    if not final_download_list:
        print("未勾选任何文件，程序退出")
        return

    total_tasks = len(final_download_list)
    print(f"\n最终待下载文件总数：{total_tasks}，并发线程：{MAX_WORKERS}")
    print("启动 curses 下载进度UI...\n")

    tasks_status.clear()
    executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=MAX_WORKERS)
    futures = []
    for tid, task_item in enumerate(final_download_list):
        fut = executor.submit(download_task, tid, task_item)
        futures.append(fut)

    curses.wrapper(curses_render)
    executor.shutdown(wait=True)

    # ========== 汇总报告 ==========
    success_list = []
    skip_list = []
    fail_list = []
    total_bytes = 0

    with task_lock:
        for info in tasks_status.values():
            fname = info["name"]
            state = info["state"]
            size = info["total"]
            total_bytes += size
            if state == STATE_SUCCESS:
                success_list.append((fname, size))
            elif state == STATE_SKIP:
                skip_list.append((fname, size))
            elif state == STATE_FAILED:
                fail_list.append((fname, info["error"]))

    print("\n" + "="*70)
    print("                        任务执行汇总报告")
    print("="*70)
    print(f"总任务数量: {total_tasks}")
    print(f"预估总大小: {human_size(total_bytes)}")
    print(f"成功下载: {len(success_list)} 个")
    print(f"本地已存在(跳过): {len(skip_list)} 个")
    print(f"下载失败: {len(fail_list)} 个")
    print("-"*70)

    if success_list:
        print(f"\n【成功列表】({len(success_list)}):")
        for name, sz in success_list:
            print(f"  &amp;#10003; {name} | {human_size(sz)}")

    if skip_list:
        print(f"\n【跳过列表】({len(skip_list)}):")
        for name, sz in skip_list:
            print(f"  ○ {name} | {human_size(sz)}")

    if fail_list:
        print(f"\n【失败列表】({len(fail_list)}):")
        for name, err in fail_list:
            print(f"  &amp;#10007; {name}")
            print(f"      原因: {err}")

    print("\n" + "="*70)
    if len(fail_list) &gt; 0:
        print("&amp;#9888; 存在失败任务，可以重新运行脚本尝试重试！")
    else:
        print("&amp;#9989; 所有任务处理完成，无失败项！")
    print("="*70)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()</pre></div><br>
